title: Prepare Search-owned read-only pivot draft through existing authorized Inspector HTTP host
goal: Integrate the already implemented CAP-INV-004 pivot draft into the server-authorized CAP-INV-002 Search result flow, reusing original Project/PreparePivot and source-identical PR #182 presence fix. A field must exist in the independently authorized projection; return origin must not be client-controlled. No query execution or mutations.
invariants: Source-identical blobs pivot.go and pivot_presence_test.go imported from immutable PR #182 SHA 82eab4cade8e20763f80509c560f61971001b7ec; no modification of #181/#182/#184/#185 or their audited SHAs
Same host SessionResolver + SearchOwner + TelemetryOwner independently reauthorize principal, tenant, environment, Search Job/run, Event.read and field classification on every POST
Only values exactly present in server-projected authorized fields generate an unexecuted CAP-INV-002 Query draft; raw denial excludes raw-derived-sensitive
Return origin is a server-chosen constant event-search, never arbitrary untrusted request input; time range is analyst-supplied and must parse but not executed as a new search
A pivot draft is not a saved Query, Search Job, Evidence, Artifact, Case linkage or production operation

The historical pivot/runtime attestation is not rewritten or called unchanged on a modified source: the E2E audit reports RuntimeUnchangedSincePivot=false only for the exact revalidated two-file amendment
security_properties: Fail closed if client supplies arbitrary authorizations, sensitive fields, unknown returnOrigin, tenant/env mismatch, removed Job, malformed query, valuePresent missing, missing empty-valued map key or invalid time range
Preserve existing Event Inspector GET/POST compatibility, no second authorization engine and no source classifications derived from HTTP client
The real host must provide IAM, field redaction, trustworthy Search/Telemetry owners, audit persistence and TLS/CSRF; current interfaces remain synthetic tests and do not prove production

migration.rationale: Only a read-only draft response; no persistence or schema change

rollback.strategy: Revert the branch and retain immutable upstream PR #182 fix and #184 host
verification: Existing Inspector HTTP JSON and tests remain unchanged

inputs: Existing CAP-INV-004 canonical action Pivoter Class-0 and transition to CAP-INV-002
Frozen #184 HTTP host and #182 presence-fix patch, both source commit SHA verified
Existing shared 3-owner host authorization and Go Project/PreparePivot
outputs: New fixed POST /investigate/event-inspection/pivot on the existing handler, not a new product or authorization owner
A bounded Query draft with authorized field value, source/enrichment provenance, time range, Event Job/run/correlation, server-derived return origin
Host checks both raw denial and true map membership including legitimate present empty values
Exact-HEAD Linux/macOS/Windows host + core module tests including race and existing global engineering security gates

Additional strict E2E revalidation branch: source-identical PR #182 pivot.go + pivot_presence_test.go ONLY, known blob hashes, and fresh targeted Go security tests, while historical E10-INV-004C verified SHA and reports stay immutable
acceptance_tests: A read-authorized Search Job + Event source field produces a canonical CAP-INV-002 pivot draft; no search execution
Missing field with value empty yields 404; present empty value still accepted
Raw-derived-sensitive field blocked when raw denied; allowed only if independently owner-authorized
Wrong tenant/environment/Job, fabricated field, query mutation, extra JSON property and invalid time range all denied without raw metadata
Existing core and new host tests, go vet, Linux race and mandatory CI checks all run on exact HEAD
Global CHK-EVENT-INSPECTION-E2E revalidates the exact two approved #182 core delta blobs and runs both new pivot-presence regression tests; any extra changed core file or blob mismatch fails closed
required_checks: cross-platform host and core Go tests, vet, race
definition_of_ready: CAP-INV-004 read-only pivot draft is canonical and OPEN-013/014 class-2 mutations excluded
G-HOST exact published #184 SHA 239ad0950f35a283e8611baf599a652966822dcb is IMPLEMENTED and validated with CI, not merged
definition_of_done: Handler returns a real owner-checked draft for a selected Event
Existing and new host+core tests verified on exact GitHub SHA
No prohibited path modified, L2 conditional on material new boundary risk; no GitHub native approved claim

performance_budget.rationale: Bounded <=8192-byte request, one Search owner and one Telemetry owner lookup and one in-memory Project+PreparePivot; synthetic benchmark only
metrics: at most one Search and one Telemetry owner read
